title: Agent contracts v1
description: Wire, tool and state contracts for Web/Core/Agent. Proposal for G1 review; see contracts/agent-v1.md.

Cursor.description: Opaque Core-issued cursor (same shape as existing Core cursors). Clients and Agent never parse it.

HistoryPosition.description: Core processing order as a decimal string (BigInt-safe).

ThreadId.description: Code-derived from trusted conversation mapping; format still open (Agent_Design #conversation-thread-mapping).

SafeText.description: Text without control characters other than tab/newline/carriage return.

SourceRef.description: Reference into the code-built source registry of the current message.

VerifiedSourceRef.description: Only retrieval evidence or Core results may back a verified finding; customer messages may not.

ConversationStatus.description: Mirrors business.ConversationStatus at the time of writing.

RetrievalIssueCode.description: Structural/source issues only; semantic sufficiency belongs to MessageWork.agent_assessment.

ConversationCreateCustomer.description: Customer create payload. Target customer and role come from the Core session, never from the body.

ConversationCreateStaff.description: Staff Copilot create payload. Fields are requests only; Core checks assignment and that the linked chat belongs to the same customer.

ConversationCreate.description: Core selects the variant from the authenticated role; the client key only deduplicates the create command.

ConversationSummary.description: currentRun = RUNNING run, else next QUEUED run, else null.

MessageSubmitAck.description: Returned only after the message and run are durably stored.

ConversationHistoryPage.description: User-facing history: user messages, accepted Agent results and filtered technical run outcomes. Not the Agent HistoryView.

HistoryView.description: Sequential view for the Agent: everything Core processed (including accepted results/outcomes) before current_message_id, never later queued messages.

LinkedHistoryView.description: Copilot source-chat snapshot frozen by Core when it accepted the Staff question; same view on every page/retry of that run.

ExecutionLimits.description: null = value not chosen yet (G4); the Agent must refuse to start a run whose required limit is null once G4 fixes it.

RunRequest.description: Core -> Agent start/redeliver request. Trusted only after service authentication.

ExecutionContext.description: Trusted runtime context for adapters only. Never sent to the model; holds no credentials.

AgentEvent.description: Agent -> Core callback envelope. sequence is per attempt and unchanged on redelivery.

DurableAck.description: Sent only after the receiver durably stored (or recognised) the request/event. event_id null for run receipts.

DocumentScope.description: Core answer to a scope request. Valid-empty = GRANTED with no documents; timeouts are transport errors, not a scope.

EvidenceLocation.description: Real source position. Markdown fixtures use anchor only; no invented page numbers.

RetrievalError.description: Filtered error: code only, never SQL, payloads or out-of-scope identifiers.

RetrievalResult.description: Exactly six fields. status describes retrieval only, not answer sufficiency.

ContractOverview.description: riders_complete is required: legacy/missing flags are normalised to false by Core, never true.

ContractListResult.description: Empty contracts with OK is a valid result.

ToolDecision.description: Exactly one tool per Agent cycle.

TicketHandoffSummary.description: Six handoff groups. Empty is allowed when nothing is known; never filled with invented facts.

TicketProposalAction.description: Proposal only. Core creates a Ticket after valid Customer confirmation (G6).

HandoffProposalAction.description: Proposal to talk to Staff; Core's existing handoff flow still requires Customer consent.

Citation.description: Filled by code from the cited evidence; the model only chooses evidence_id.

AgentResult.description: Final, validated result. Exactly four fields.

AnswerDraft.description: Agent node output before Finalize fills citation metadata.

AgentDecision.description: Agent node union output: one tool request or one answer draft.

PendingClarification.description: PROPOSED until Core accepts the CLARIFICATION result; only ASKED is used to interpret the next message.

HistorySummary.description: Summary of older own-conversation history; covers_through is the last Core position it replaces.

ConversationContext.description: Kept across messages of one conversation/thread. Never proves permissions.

SourceOutput.description: Raw tool outcome recorded by code; replaced=true keeps provenance but removes it from model context.

AgentAssessment.description: LLM interpretation inside the Agent node; separate from tool output and never a permission decision.

UnverifiedCondition.description: Condition identified from a real source but not yet checked; basis_refs prevents invented conditions.

WorkCounters.description: Mirror for context/trace. The durable ledger (Task 2/4) is authoritative for budgets.

MessageWork.description: Per-message work. New message = new work and budget; same message/new attempt keeps it (ledger rules in Task 2).

RevocationReason.description: Why Core stops an attempt (G2 proposal).

AttemptRevocation.description: Core -> Agent control request (G2 proposal). Core refuses the attempt's tools/events as soon as it records INVALIDATING; a new writer for the thread is dispatched only after a RevocationAck with REVOKED/ALREADY_REVOKED.

RevocationAck.description: Agent -> Core, sent only after the Agent store committed the revoke (ownership epoch raised; unknown attempts get a tombstone). writer_epoch is the epoch now required for the thread.
